items.title: 3 Legacy Industrial Dividend Stocks That Never Go Out of Style
items.summary: Two recessions and a pandemic could not stop these three industrial giants from paying shareholders. Each one also hides a risk retirees should weigh before counting on the next raise, and one stock has already tumbled 24% in a month.

items.summary: WAB's raised 2026 earnings outlook, expanding margins and $31.44 billion backlog support growth, but revenue misses and delivery risks keep execution in focus.

items.title: Divided Government Is Back: 4 Steady Passive Income Dividend Stocks to Own
items.summary: When Washington locks up, some paychecks keep flowing. Four companies across insurance, water, food, and rail earn their cash where a split Congress has little reach, and one of them hasn't skipped a dividend raise in 44 years.
